IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with
shoulder-length light brown hair stands
on a green lawn. She wears a fitted
sleeveless white collared dress with a
deep V neckline and a pleated mini skirt
with a brown leather belt. She carries a
gray quilted shoulder bag on a tan strap.
Her expression is calm, looking off to the
side. Soft, natural daylight. Palette of
white, green, and warm brown. Fresh
and preppy, in the style of a summer
street-style editorial.
